Chief_Complaint.content: Patient presents with feeling really anxious for approximately 2 months.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Onset of anxiety symptoms after starting a new fashion-retail head-office job with a hostile boss and high stress.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Onset after starting new fashion-retail head-office job; hostile boss, high stress

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Experiences morning dread about leaving the house and worry about being late.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Morning dread leaving house, worry about lateness

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Reports palpitations that are irregular and rapid, lasting 2–10 minutes, mainly on waking.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Palpitations: irregular, rapid, 2–10 min, mainly on waking

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Has sleep-onset insomnia, going to bed between 22-23 h and taking hours to fall asleep.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Sleep-onset insomnia (bed 22-23 h, hrs to fall asleep)

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Experiences early waking with total sleep of 3–4 hours and shallow sleep.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: early waking; total sleep 3–4 h; shallow sleep

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Reports anhedonia and feeling on edge.
Avoids friends and activities such as running and tennis.
Denies full panic attacks and has always managed to get to work.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: No full panic attacks; has always made it to work

Medications.content: Patient is not taking any medications.

Family_History.content: Mother has a history of depression.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Alcohol use includes binge drinking on Friday and Saturday above recommended limits and mid-week wine.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: etOH: binge Fri/Sat (> limit) + mid-week wine

Assessment.content: Work-related anxiety, possible generalized anxiety disorder or adjustment disorder.
Palpitations likely anxiety-related with need to rule out organic causes.
Assessment.source_text: 2. Palpitations – likely anxiety-related; r/o organic causes

Assessment.content: Low mood consistent with subthreshold depression.

Plan_of_Care.content: Provide self-referral link to NHS talking therapy, specifically CBT.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Provide self-referral link to NHS talking therapy (CBT)

Plan_of_Care.content: Share online anxiety and sleep-hygiene resources.
Order baseline blood tests including FBC, U&E, TFTs, etc., via support line.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Order baseline bloods (FBC, U&E, TFTs, etc.) via support line

Plan_of_Care.content: No medications to be started for now; consider medications if therapy is insufficient.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • No meds for now; consider if therapy insufficient

Plan_of_Care.content: Counsel patient on reducing alcohol intake.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Counsel on etOH reduction, graded exercise, social engagement
• Counsel on etOH reduction, graded exercise, social engagement
• Counsel on etOH reduction, graded exercise, social engagement

Follow_up_Information.content: Arrange GP follow-up 1 week after blood tests to review results and symptoms.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: • GP f/u 1 wk post-bloods to review results & symptoms

Follow_up_Information.content: Advise patient to return if symptoms worsen, function is impaired, or any suicidal ideation develops.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: • Advise return if worsening, impaired function, or any SI
